# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** eleven years old  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne Shirley has a little pointed chin, gray eyes, and cheeks faintly flushed with pink. At one point, her unbraided hair streams behind her in a bright torrent, though it is also described as being green.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P24](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0024)_

## Personality

Anne Shirley is a talkative, generous, and careless child who possesses a vivid imagination. She is driven by a strong desire to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and aspires to grow up to be good-looking and to become a teacher. Known to confess her mistakes and take responsibility for her actions, she also strives to attend events like picnics. Additionally, she prefers to be called Cordelia rather than her actual name.

## History

Anne Shirley comes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as an orphan child sent by mistake instead of a boy, but after initial reluctance from [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), she is officially adopted into the home. Over time, [Anne](../character/anne.md) forms a profound bond with her neighbor [Diana Barry](../character/di.md), solemnly pledging eternal friendship. Her vivid imagination and impulsiveness frequently lead to mishaps, such as accidentally serving [Diana](../character/diana.md) wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing a temporary rift with Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) that [Anne](../character/anne.md) later mends by saving Diana's sick little sister. [Anne](../character/anne.md) continuously faces humblings and hardships, including breaking her ankle during a dare on a roof and being forced to crop her hair short after mistakenly dying it green. Academically ambitious, she pursues studies under her beloved teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), earning a place in the elite Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) class alongside her long-standing rival, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). After excelling at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and winning a college scholarship, Anne's life takes a dramatic shift when Marilla's failing eyesight threatens the future of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Choosing family over her advanced ambitions, [Anne](../character/anne.md) relinquishes her scholarship to remain at home as the local teacher—a position [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) selflessly yields to her, bringing an end to their rivalry and sealing their new friendship.

## Quotes

> "I’ll fold them nicely tonight. They always made us do that at the asylum. Half the time, though, I’d forget, I’d be in such a hurry to get into bed nice and quiet and imagine things."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002)

> "I’d do anything to oblige you. But you’ll have to tell me what to say for this once. After I get into bed I’ll imagine out a real nice prayer to say always. I believe that it will be quite interesting, now that I come to think of it."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P15](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0015)

> "But I’d be ever so much gratefuller if—if you’d made just one of them with puffed sleeves. Puffed sleeves are so fashionable now. It would give me such a thrill, Marilla, just to wear a dress with puffed sleeves."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

> "I’ll just eat one tonight, Marilla. And I can give Diana half of them, can’t I? The other half will taste twice as sweet to me if I give some to her. It’s delightful to think I have something to give her."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P45](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0045)

## Relationships

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

[Di](../character/di.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) hit it off immediately after being introduced, solemnly vowing to be best friends forever. They share sweets, spend their free time together, and visit one another during times of illness and recovery. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) breaks her ankle after a dare, [Di](../character/di.md) is among the friends who visit her bedside while she heals.

- Friend of — close friends and chums  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Diana](../character/diana.md) is Anne's closest companion and best friend in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their bond faces severe strain when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally gets [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk on currant wine, leading Diana's mother to briefly forbid them from playing together. However, [Anne](../character/anne.md) restores her standing with the family by saving Diana's young sister from croup, after which the two resume their devoted friendship and frequent imaginative adventures.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is Anne's intense academic rival, though their relationship is largely defined by Anne's grudges and unspoken regrets. Even after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her from a sinking dory, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stubbornly rejects his attempts to apologize and offer friendship. Despite her refusal to speak to him, seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in an audience spurs her pride and motivates her to perform exceptionally.
